caption: The drawing depicts a high-heeled woman's shoe shown from three different angles: side, front-top, and back-side views. Each shoe is rendered in pink with areas of white and pale cream highlights, suggesting a shiny or patent-leather surface. The shoes have a rounded toe, a strap running across the instep and securing with a side button, and a high, flared heel that is cream-colored. The outline of the shoes is drawn in black ink, defining their shape and details. The shoes are colored predominantly in shades of pink, with cream and white areas indicating light reflections or glossiness. The background is plain and uncolored, and there is a small handwritten signature, "Lilian Chrusey," in the bottom right corner.
title: Woman's Slippers
